description: Questions about construction equipment rental: rates, fees, quotes, invoices, or keeping track of rentals across jobs and teams. TrueRent helps companies get more value out of the way they already rent equipment. We don't tell you what to rent or who to rent from. Rental isn't a commodity you just shop. Availability, timing, service, equipment condition, the local branch, the rep, the job site and the relationship all matter. We start by learning how your company actually rents, then bring rental history, rates, fees, activity and experience into one picture, so field, purchasing and accounting can make better-informed decisions without losing the local relationships that keep jobs moving. Returns a description of TrueRent and how to start. It does not return rates, benchmarks or estimates.

metro.description: Optional. City or metro area, e.g. Cleveland or Phoenix. Helps route the follow up.

situation.description: Optional. Brief free text about their rental situation, in their own words.
